passage: What Zodiac Signs Are Compatible With Geminis? All About Their Best (and Worst) Matches From fire signs like Aries and Leo to water signs like Pisces, here’s everything to know about Gemini compatibility, according to astrologers By Katie Mannion Katie Mannion Katie Mannion is a contributing writer at PEOPLE. She has been working at PEOPLE since 2022. Her work has previously been published in Healthline, SheKnows and more. People Editorial Guidelines Published on May 19, 2024 10:30AM EDT Credit : Chloe Jeong/PEOPLE Gemini is often considered the most disliked sign in the zodiac, although “most misunderstood sign” would be a more apt description — that is, until they find the right match. Since celestial twins symbolize the sign, Gemini tends to be unfairly stereotyped as two-faced or manipulative. In reality, though, Geminis have a natural duality and an inherent ability to see both perspectives of any situation. “They may have two sides to their personalities: One they show the world, and one they keep hidden,” says Kyle Thomas, PEOPLE’s resident celebrity astrologer. However, he says, they aren’t deceptive or disingenuous. On the contrary, “Gemini is a master of ideas, words and connection,” says Thomas. Ruled by Mercury, the planet of communication and expression, Geminis “are gifted at being flexible and versatile in connecting with others.” When it comes to romance, though, Geminis have a reputation for being somewhat flighty and noncommittal, says author and astrologer, Bethany Nicole. They tend to crave “change, freedom and movement,” which can make long-term relationships more challenging. “They can suddenly lose interest in someone for no apparent reason and be on to the next person before the previous one even knows what happened,” she tells PEOPLE. Despite this flakiness, Geminis are fun-loving and enthusiastic partners. “Gemini sees love as an exploration of themselves, others and the world,” says Thomas. As we head into Gemini season — which usually runs from May 21 to June 20 but starts on May 20 to June 20 in 2024 — here’s everything to know about Gemini’s compatibility with other zodiac signs. What are the key traits of Gemini? Like most air signs, Geminis are cerebral and curious. They prefer thinking over feeling, freedom over stability. “Gemini is a fun, flirtatious and fast-moving sign,” says Nicole, adding that they are “always up for a new idea or adventure.” As the first air sign of the zodiac — and the third sign overall — Geminis have an especially youthful and lively spirit. They are playful, optimistic and almost childlike in their enthusiasm. “Geminis are curious about everything,” says Thomas. “They take a highly intellectual view of the world, ready to learn about everything and everyone.” Masterful communicators, those born under a Gemini sun sign are social butterflies who can talk to anyone. They can sometimes be perceived as superficial or inauthentic because they can easily fit in anywhere, but they are just highly adaptable. They are also open-minded, although this can also be misunderstood. Geminis can play devil’s advocate, which can be seen as hypocritical. However, they genuinely enjoy engaging in debates as an intellectual exercise. Rather than looking at the world as black and white, they prefer to spot for the various shades of gray. “They are able to see problems, obstacles and people from a variety of viewpoints,” says Nicole. Because of their “charismatic and charming” demeanor, Geminis “are a source of great inspiration to those around them,” she says. However, they can be prone to gossip, restlessness and boredom, so when it comes to relationships, “they need fast-paced partners who can keep up with them and present new ideas and adventures.” Which signs are most compatible with Gemini? According to Thomas, Gemini tend to get along best with fire signs (Aries, Leo and Sagittarius) and fellow air signs (Libra and Aquarius). Astrologically speaking, fire and air signs are considered masculine elements, he explains, meaning they have a more active energy. “They seek to learn, communicate and engage, and they’re often extroverted, highly adventurous and impulsive," he says. Fire signs are known for being passionate and action-oriented, so Gemini will never get bored. As for air signs, Gemini will find a partner that easily understands them. “They are able to connect on an intellectual rapport which promotes trust,” Thomas explains. Aries Aries and Gemini. Chloe Jeong/PEOPLE Bold, brash Aries is one of the best partners for Gemini. “Energetically, they are a good match,” says Nicole. Both are fast-moving signs that value their independence and are likely to understand each other with ease. “They tend to process things in similar ways,” she explains, although they differ greatly when it comes to decision-making. Aries has a take-charge personality that lends itself to strong leadership and resolution, whereas Gemini is more whimsical and indecisive. However, this can work in their favor: Gemini can help Aries become more open-minded, while Aries can motivate Gemini to “accomplish their goals.” This pairing is “especially fun and spontaneous,” says Thomas, adding that these two can create an adventurous romance that brings “a great deal of mutual intellectual growth.” Claire Danes, an Aries, and her Gemini husband, Hugh Dancy are a perfect example. The couple have been married since 2009 and share three children. Leo Leo and Gemini. Chloe Jeong/PEOPLE Another fire sign that pairs well with Gemini is Leo. “This is one of the best matches in the zodiac,” says Thomas, adding that the relationship between these two “promotes fun, adventure and growth.” Like Geminis, Leos are incredibly social and fun-loving. “Both like to be the life of the party,” says Nicole and “they can be drawn to each other’s vivacity and excitement.” These signs tend to crave the spotlight, so while they can understand each other, they may also struggle with competitiveness, she adds. However, as long as support goes both ways, they “can become a real power couple.” Libra Libra and Gemini. -. Chloe Jeong/PEOPLE Geminis enjoy debate and drama, whereas Libras prefer balance and harmony, yet these two are highly compatible. “This is a glorious match,” says Thomas. As an air sign, Libra values connection and communication as much as Gemini. Libras are just as charming and social as Geminis, so they have the potential for a “perfect long-term connection.” These two also share an intellectual curiosity and will “always find new and interesting things to talk about and ways of looking at the world,” says Nicole. However, both can be indecisive and flighty, so a commitment may take some time. Still, they have the potential for both friendship and romance. Blake Shelton and Gwen Stefani exemplify this type of Gemini-Libra compatibility. The couple wed in 2021, seven years after they first met. Aquarius Chloe Jeong/PEOPLE Gemini and Aquarius balance each other out in the best way. According to Thomas, an Aquarius-Gemini couple is “one of the best matches in the zodiac.” Aquarius is known for being cerebral and quirky, while Gemini is playful and curious. “They both will find one another fascinating and exciting,” says Thomas. Gemini can be restless and unpredictable, which can be difficult for certain signs. Aquarius can hold their own, though, says Nicole. “Aquarius is stoic enough not to get caught up in [Geminis drama] but adventurous and innovative enough to hold their attention," she adds. Although it’s an air sign, Aquarius has a few earth-sign traits, Nicole explains. They provide a certain level of groundedness that’s “exactly what Gemini needs.” Take lifelong pals Courteney Cox and Jennifer Aniston. The Friends costars have been real-life best friends since the '90s. Which signs are least compatible with Gemini? In general, Gemini is least compatible with water signs (Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces) along with earth signs (Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn), says Thomas. “Air signs are highly intellectual and crave constant stimulation and engagement,” he says. Earth signs are practical and “tend to be set in their ways,” while water signs are known for being “tremendously emotional.” Capricorn Capricorn and Gemini. Chloe Jeong/PEOPLE Spontaneous, adventure-loving Gemini will likely butt heads with the rigid, responsible Capricorn. These two are complete opposites in almost every way. “Capricorn is the sign of ‘no’ while Gemini is the sign of ‘yes,’ ” Nicole tells PEOPLE. “Gemini prefers freedom in their work environment, and Capricorn thrives in stability.” They also differ when it comes to financial decisions and social engagements, which can take a toll on a relationship. Still, the signs can “come together and create balance,” but it takes a great deal of work. “More often, Gemini feels tied down and misunderstood while Capricorn feels ignored and unheard," she adds. Cancer Aries and Gemini. Chloe Jeong/PEOPLE Watery Cancer is known for being emotional, introverted and sensitive, so it’s no surprise they’re not the best pairing for Gemini. “This match can be particularly challenging,” says Thomas. “They have very different worldviews, particularly around the role of social versus domestic life.” Cancers have strong ties to home and family, whereas Geminis want to explore the world, which can create a disconnect. Although sometimes opposite signs can work well together, each providing something the other needs, that isn’t the case here. Gemini is all about movement, adventure and logic, while Cancer prioritizes security, intuition and comfort. The restless and fast-paced Gemini “can feel like an uncontrollable force” to Cancer, Nicole says. Meanwhile, Cancer's sensitive nature can “feel like a wet blanket” to Gemini. Pisces Picses and Gemini. Chloe Jeong/PEOPLE Pisces is another water sign that doesn’t always mesh well with Gemini. “Pisces and Gemini share a dualistic nature, meaning they can understand each other in a way many of the other signs do not,” says Nicole. Both signs are also “very insightful and intuitive” but have different energies. Gemini is restless and adventurous, whereas Pisces is dreamy and peaceful. Pisceans are also one of the most emotionally deep signs in the zodiac, while Geminis are often described as superficially charming, which creates a lot of underlying tension. While a Gemini-Pisces relationship “can start out quite fun,” the excitement doesn’t typically last. “They will find one another a bit triggering over time,” says Thomas. “They’ll realize they have great difficulty communicating.” What is Gemini’s compatibility with other signs? Gemini Gemini and Gemini. Chloe Jeong/PEOPLE Most of the time, couples with the same zodiac sign are well-matched. However, when two Geminis come together, it can go either way. “On a positive note, this match can feel like a perfect flow,” says Thomas, noting that they may even feel like they’ve found their soulmate. However, one Gemini alone is a whirlwind, so together, they can become more like a hurricane. “They can have a great deal of difficulty finding stability," he adds. Still, Geminis are often attracted to each other like magnets. “They are likely to gravitate towards each other over and over,” Nicole says. “But it can be tough for them to make a commitment.” Scorpio Scorpio and Gemini. Chloe Jeong/PEOPLE Gemini and Scorpio are two other pairings that tend to become toxic at worst and unsustainable at best. “There is usually a lot of initial attraction,” says Nicole, but it rarely leads to a lasting relationship. “Energetically, they have very different natures, and attempts to change the other [tend] to blow up.” Thomas agrees, saying that although there is an instant spark between them, “more often than not, it will just create chaos.” Sagittarius Sagittarius and Gemini. Chloe Jeong/PEOPLE According to Thomas, Gemini and Sagittarius is either “a perfect match or a total explosion.” Like Gemini, Sagittarius is a mutable sign known for being free-spirited and optimistic. “These two are fast-moving and make great adventure partners,” says Nicole. “They understand each other’s need for speed and new ideas, people, places and things.” However, both signs are known for being impulsive and non-committal, so that can lead to an on-again, off-again dynamic rather than lasting love. To make it work, these two “will need to find a way to make sure they’re on the same page,” says Thomas. Close Read more: Human Interest Astrology

passage: I love you Geminis—not least of all because you have quite the astrological reputation. Some might call you flaky, two-faced or unpredictable, but let’s be real, those people are just jealous. It’s not easy to keep up with your dazzling wit, impeccable taste and relentless sense of adventure! (Believe me, I’ve tried!) Gemini Personality Traits Geminis, born between May 21 and June 20, are known for their dual nature. Represented by the twins, they are versatile, communicative and intellectually curious. As an air sign, Geminis are social butterflies who thrive on interactions and love to share their thoughts and ideas. They are ruled by Mercury, the planet of communication, which gives them their gift of gab and ability to adapt to different situations quickly. How We Ranked The Best & Worst Zodiac Compatible Signs for Geminis To determine the compatibility of each sign with Gemini, I considered astrological charts, personality traits and relationship dynamics. My rankings are based on my personal work as a astrologer, which includes my own astrological studies, personal experiences and insights from other respected astrologers. I took this well-rounded method to help provide a comprehensive view of Gemini compatibility that may differ from other sources. What signs are most compatible with Geminis? 1. Gemini and Pisces (February 19 - March 20) This might be a surprise to other signs— “Isn’t Gemini too aloof for Pisces?” “Isn’t Pisces too weepy for Gemini?” But any Gemini who loves (or has loved) a Pisces knows that this is the match. Pisces and Gemini are both mutable signs which means if nothing else, they go with the flow. Gemini gives Pisces the deep respect that the fish deserves (other signs tend to write them off as “too emo to function”). In return, Pisces makes Gemini feel truly seen, like they’re always at home. These two really connect on an almost cellular level. It’s an instant soulmate bond. Pisces is also the only sign that can turn restless Gemini into a couch potato. For these two, there’s no heaven quite like being themselves (and binging The Great British Baking Show) together. 2. Gemini and Libra (September 23 - October 22) Gemini and Libra are both geeks and love to geek out together. This is a true intellectual match where both feel comfortable showing off their freaky (and kinky) sides. A first date with these two lasts for hours whether they’re gossiping about a mutual acquaintance or debating critical theory. They literally never run out of things to talk about and once they commit to each other, they usually develop their own secret language or code (much to the annoyance of everyone around them who isn’t in on the joke). Both are extremely driven and charismatic and even though both like to flirt outside of the relationship, who says jealousy isn’t a turn on? These two have unmatched chemistry and never grow bored of each other. Truly an A+ connection. 3. Gemini and Aries (March 21 - April 19) Gemini and Aries are a power couple. Just like with Leo, Gemini is immediately attracted to Aries’ confidence, but also appreciates that Aries isn’t trying so hard to stand out. These two know how to let their guards down together and care very little about poise or sophistication. Aries is an amazing cheerleader, always getting Gemini pumped up to show their best self to the world. In return, Gemini is a muse for Aries, inspiring many of the ram’s best ideas. Together, Gemini and Aries are fearless and encourage each other to explore their kinkier side in the bedroom. The only problem with this relationship is that it can sometimes feel like Peter Pan hanging out with the lost boys and neither ever wants to be the adult in the room. As long as one never bosses the other around though, this match can certainly last. 4. Gemini and Gemini (May 21 - June 20) Though other signs might be intimidated when two Geminis come together, this is in many ways a perfect match. Yes, both are flaky, indirect and hard to pin down. But no one calls a Gemini out like another Gemini. For example: Two people meet on a dating app. They chat, flirt and make a date. An hour before the date, one (a known Gemini) tries to cancel on the other (also a Gemini) because he just doesn’t feel like it. The other says “I get you,” but encourages them to meet anyway. Both make it to the date (late, of course), grab a drink and sit down. Both are so used to having to steer every conversation that how easily things flow between them is an immediate turn on. Flirtation gets heavy and sparks fly! As they kiss goodbye, one Gemini says to the other, “See? This never would have happened if you flaked!” before disappearing into the night, keeping both of their interests peaked. Before you know it, they’re living together. This relationship isn’t always about the chase, but both know how to be playful and keep the mystery alive! 5. Gemini and Leo (July 23 - August 22) When culture vulture Gemini meets style maven Leo, the sparks definitely fly! Leo is immediately impressed by Gemini’s intellect and Gemini can’t get enough of Leo’s party animal ways. These two are the couple that dances all night at the club and keeps going through brunch the next day. Everyone wants to be around their good vibes! Together, they’re royalty! This is the JFK (Gemini) and Jackie O (Leo) relationship after all. The only problem with this connection is that sometimes it’s too much of a good thing. Neither is ever lacking in the self-confidence department so if one ever damages the other’s ego—well, that’s a declaration of war. As long as these two are able to gas each other up though, it’s a match made in heaven. 6. Gemini and Aquarius (January 20 - February 18) Like Gemini, Aquarius has a reputation for being aloof. It’s not that these two air signs don’t care, it’s that they both value their freedom more than anything else. When Gemini and Aquarius get together, it’s a real meeting of the minds. More than any other sign, Aquarius pushes Gemini to get serious about their goals and make their dreams come true. In return, Gemini inspires Aquarius to connect with their passions and have more fun. Gemini brings out Aquarius’ inner child! Though these two aren’t the most romantic match, they’re definitely a power couple. Other signs (like Taurus or Cancer) might crave more of a fairytale story, but these hilarious geniuses are happy to do their own thing. Independence is bliss! What signs are least compatible with Geminis? 7. Gemini and Scorpio (October 23 - November 21) This match shouldn’t work, but somehow...it does. Maybe because these two are the most consistently maligned signs of the zodiac, they bond over everyone’s ridiculous misconceptions of them. They get off on being misunderstood. Gemini is freewheeling while Scorpio is serious as a heart attack. But they bring out the best in each other. No one appreciates Scorpio’s (dark) sense of humor like Gemini, and no one asks Gemini the hard questions like Scorpio. Even though Scorpio is a fixed sign and too much consistency is a major turn off for Gemini, Scorpio is also ruled by Mars. Scorpio wants to keep moving as much as Gemini wants to keep talking. Though these two don’t find each other easily, when they do get together: It’s meant to be. 8. Gemini and Sagittarius (November 22 - December 21) Gemini and Sagittarius are opposite signs. Debatably, of all the opposites in the zodiac, these two are actually the most similar. Both love freedom, exploration and know the value of a good debate. When they come together, their arguments are their foreplay. Geminis are like curious kids at a party, always asking “Why?” and wanting to find out as much information as possible (about anything and everything). Sagittarians on the other hand, like to make small talk into a PhD dissertation. Though these two both get off on intellect and find each other sexy and exciting, Gemini might find Sagittarius a bit pretentious and lacking a sense of humor. Every conversation doesn’t need to begin with a thesis statement! Sometimes, Gemini just wants to vibe. 9. Gemini and Virgo (August 23 - September 22) Gemini and Virgo are both ruled by communication planet Mercury. These two have a lot in common and an instant rapport. Both are obsessed with collecting information, dissecting it and proving to everyone that they’re right. They’re mutually gifted at telling stories, crafting projects and keeping up with dozens of group chats. This can make them a match made in heaven (if their preferences align) or each other’s worst nightmare (if they come from opposite ends of any spectrum). Gemini especially loves to challenge those with differing opinions, never resting until they get to the bottom of why someone is the way they are. This can be extremely stressful to Virgo who is also curious but way more sensitive than Gemini. Though we’d love to be a fly on the wall for any conversation between these two, we can’t promise that they’ll get along. 10. Gemini and Cancer (June 21 - July 22) Like Taurus, Cancer is another sign that loves comfort and stability. Cancers are known for being the mom of the zodiac. And though many signs run to Cancer for comfort, connection and a delicious home cooked meal, Geminis can’t stand their bossiness. And TBH, they often find Cancers to be pretty boring. Cancers are a cardinal (aka leadership) sign, so ultimately they want to be in charge. Geminis prefer to answer to no one. Though these two signs sit right next to each other on the zodiac (and they’re more similar than they’d like to believe), they’ll never see eye to eye. Gemini’s elusiveness annoys Cancer to no end. They can have a great bougie night on the town though but for everyone’s sake, they should skip going home together at the end of the date. 11. Gemini and Taurus (April 20 - May 20) With Taurus as the most loyal sign in the zodiac and Gemini having an extremely flirtatious reputation, these two only come together when they’re looking for trouble. This match causes instant and constant drama. Taurus just wants stability and Gemini just wants freedom. And though these things don’t have to be diametrically opposed, the more Taurus tries to control Gemini’s schedule, the more Gemini rebels. Why the constant Netflix and chill when there’s so much to explore? These two are initially attracted to each other’s optimistic outlook—both are springtime babies with a general zest for life. But once Gemini realizes that Taurus is content with ordering the same eggs Benedict at the same brunch spot for all eternity, the spark is extinguished. Life without novelty is death for a Gemini. 12. Gemini and Capricorn (December 22 - January 19) On paper, Gemini and Capricorn have almost nothing in common and this is pretty true in practice as well. While Capricorns are traditionalists, Geminis are obsessed with current culture. While Geminis can barely schedule their day, Capricorns always have a 30-year plan. One’s texting 67 people at a time while the other is methodically keeping a bullet journal. Mutable air meets Cardinal earth: How could they possibly get along? The one thing that could bring these two together is a mutual love of antiques or classic luxury items. These two could even have an amazing day wandering galleries at the Met or the Museum of Natural History. Wherever lots of information meets history, these two are on the same page. That is, until Gemini gets bored and quickly moves onto the next thing. Can You Have a Successful Relationship with a Gemini If Your Signs Aren't Compatible? Absolutely! Compatibility goes beyond just astrological signs. I have seen supposedly toxic Gemini and Capricorn couples that are far more compatible than more favorable pairings because they put in the work that a relationship takes to really understand each other and communciate. With effort, communication, and understanding, any relationship can thrive. It’s about embracing each other’s differences and finding common ground. Is There a Difference in Friendship vs. Love Compatibility with Geminis? Yes, there can be. In friendships, Geminis often seek intellectual stimulation and shared adventures (which is why you might find a Gem and an Aquarius really hitting it off as colleagues in the office). In romantic relationships, they value communication, trust and mutual interests. Understanding these nuances can help in fostering both types of relationships. Recapping Gemini Compatible Signs Geminis thrive with partners who can match their energy, intellect, and curiosity. While some signs may present more challenges, any relationship can succeed with effort and understanding. Jaime Wright is an astrologer based in New York.
